targets.title: Perceived responsibility to address climate change consistently relates to increased pro-environmental attitudes, behaviors and policy support: Evidence across 23 countries
targets.evidence_quote: Through a secondary-analysis of nationally representative samples of 31 European countries from the ESS, we replicated the results found by Syropoulos and Markowitz (2022).
targets.outcome_quote: All correlational findings for measures overlapping across ESS waves were replicated (within and across all countries).

targets.title: When worry about climate change leads to climate action: How values, worry and personal responsibility relate to various climate actions
targets.evidence_quote: The current study replicates and extends recent work (Bouman et al., 2020; Syropoulos & Markowitz, 2022) which found a meaningful and robust relationship between people's feelings of responsibility to reduce climate change, their worry about climate change, and their belief that climate change is caused by humans.
targets.outcome_quote: The current study replicates and extends recent work (Bouman et al., 2020; Syropoulos & Markowitz, 2022) which found a meaningful and robust relationship between people's feelings of responsibility to reduce climate change, their worry about climate change, and their belief that climate change is caused by humans. Importantly, these findings were consistently observed across 31 different European countries, and when controlling for crucial socio-demographic variables.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The publisher discussion preview explicitly places both named originals inside the replicated-and-extended set and states agreement on the relationship. This is independent evidence of a retested target rather than mere topical background.
